parts.title: Secret Entrance
parts.summary: A circular safe dial numbered 0 through 99 starts at 50. Apply an ordered sequence of left (L) and right (R) click rotations modulo 100 and count how many rotations leave the dial resting on 0.
parts.algorithmSummary: Direct Euclidean modular simulation: parse instructions into immutable Rotation value objects in 2025/day01/shared, pre-reduce each rotation distance modulo 100 before signed addition, and fold through shared/core euclideanMod while counting resting positions at 0.
parts.complexity: O(N) time, O(N) parsed / O(1) solver working space
learnings: Promoted euclideanMod to shared/core/math.ts to avoid JavaScript negative remainder and -0 pitfalls.
Personal input includes multi-turn rotations up to 998 clicks; always pre-reduce distance modulo ring size instead of single-wrap conditionals.
Placing shared day input parsing and value objects in 2025/day01/shared preserves full rotation distances cleanly for Part 2.

parts.title: Secret Entrance
parts.summary: Using the same 0–99 safe dial starting at 50 and rotation sequence from Part 1, count every individual click that lands the pointer on 0—both intermediate pass-throughs (including multi-turn loops) and exact end-of-rotation landings.

proposals.name: First-Hit Modular Arithmetic
proposals.summary: Compute clicks to the first zero crossing (100 - p for R; p === 0 ? 100 : p for L) and count 1 + floor((d - firstHit) / 100) in O(1) per rotation.
proposals.tradeoffs: Pure non-negative safe-integer math with zero negative-floor quirks or cumulative overflow; verified against a click-by-click test oracle.

proposals.name: Unwrapped Number-Line Floor Difference
proposals.summary: Track cumulative unwrapped position x and subtract floor(x/100) intervals across each step.
proposals.tradeoffs: Requires subtle -1 offset for leftward half-open intervals and cumulative coordinate can grow unboundedly on synthetic inputs.

proposals.name: Direct Single-Click Simulation
proposals.summary: Step the dial by +/-1 mod 100 for every individual click and increment when position hits 0.
proposals.tradeoffs: Trivially faithful to the spec (ideal differential test oracle), but linear in total click distance.

parts.selectionRationale: O(1) per rotation with purely non-negative safe-integer arithmetic cleanly resolving the p = 0 left/right asymmetry, placed cohesively on Rotation in 2025/day01/shared/.
parts.inFlightWork: Adding Rotation.countZeroHitsFrom, Part 2 domain solver + differential tests, and Archimedean spiral-sweep SVG visualizer via Flash.
